scope: Exploratory crosswalk between catalogue facets and MeSH descriptor topics. Associations are not equivalence, formal subsumption, applicability or publication-type assertions. MeSH Browser 2026 and selected observed descriptor list in #193. Unknown and broad mixed-methods labels are deliberately left unmapped.
cautions: Research Design is broader than Experimental studies. Clinical Trial Protocols as Topic is narrower than generic Study protocols. Diagnostic methods, prognostic factors, and prediction are distinct; their candidate descriptors do not exhaust the label. Cost-analysis and cost-benefit descriptors are partial topics, not synonyms for all economic evaluations. Report-section links identify narrower or related methodological topics, never report-section equivalence. Oncology specialty and neoplasm disease subject are different facets. Mixed methods requires a separately verified composite definition.
